pages.title: Steppe Bison
pages.text: The steppe bison ($(o)Bison priscus$()) is an extinct bison that roamed the cold mammoth steppe of Europe, northern Asia and northern North America during the Pleistocene.$(br2)It was a large grazer with a pronounced shoulder hump and long, forward-curving horns.$(br2)Steppe bison are among the animals most often painted in Ice Age caves such as Lascaux and Altamira, and a frozen mummy nicknamed Blue Babe was found in Alaska.
